'''James Earl Cash''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]], appearing as the [[Protagonist|player character]] in [[Manhunt]] who appears on wanted posters in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]], although it is unknown what he is wanted for. Cash, who had lived in [[Las Venturas]], was sentenced to death after being convicted for an unknown crime. His execution, however, is a hoax orchestrated by The Director who has Cash brutally murder members of various gangs in cordoned off sections of [[Carcer City]] for his snuff films. Cash performs the murders but manages to escape before press discover the snuff film ring and the involvement of the Carcer City Police Department.

==Murders committed==
*White Rabbit - <small>(Killed to gain hold of the key to escape Darkwoods Penitentiary) </small>
*Ramirez - <small>(Killed attempting to kill Cash) </small>
*Cerberus Leader  -<small>(Killed to gain hold of the elevator key to reach Starkweather)</small>
*Piggsy - <small>(Killed for attempting to kill Cash) </small>
*Lionel Starkweather - <small>(Killed for forcing Cash to kill gang members, ordering the brutal deaths of his family members, and later trying to kill him) </small>

==Trivia==
*Rockstar named James Earl Cash after the real life killer, James Earl Ray.
*James Earl Cash action figures can be found in the [[Zero RC]] shop in [[San Fierro]] in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].
*In Manhunt 2 a billboard can be read that says "JEC and Sons Construction", a reference to to James Earl Cash.  
*Wanted posters for Cash can be found inside the police stations in [[Las Venturas]] and San Fierro.
